title: Perfect app
body: This app is great for my boyfriend (pilot) and I (flight attendant) to upload our schedules and be able to see it on one screen. I love that it tells us when we are both home and can see our commutes! Totally worth $99/year!

title: Great Tracking App
body: Great app for my family to track where I am when I’m out on the road. They can get live flight tracking. It’s a one stop shop for personal flight tracking and creating better situation awareness for my loved ones.

title: A must have!
body: One app. Total visibility. Zero hassle. No more repeatedly telling your spouse, family, or friends where you are, what time you fly, or what time it is at your destination. This app is the one-stop shop for your travel details—flight numbers, schedules, locations, and more—all in one place so the people who care about you can easily stay informed and track your journey. Simple. Smart. Seamless. Peace of mind.

title: No more guessing where my spouse is!
body: Great app that is interactive, easily tracks his flights and down time. No more emails of screen shots of each trip he has.
